text:
You need a Cloudflare Workers email trigger that reliably captures each incoming message, stores the full message object in Postgres, and includes Sentry plus clear setup instructions so you can reproduce it on your own Cloudflare and Neon.tech accounts.

I’ve built similar full-stack systems where careful data handling and auditability mattered. In an embedded customer analytics project, I built usage dashboards in React/TypeScript/Node.js/PostgreSQL and rolled them out to 140 customer accounts, 3 weeks early. In a clinic patient portal, I built booking, lab results, and SMS reminders in Next.js/NestJS/PostgreSQL, with every record view written to an audit trail; it supported 11k patient registrations.

I can help debug your current Worker, make the email ingestion and Postgres write flow reliable, wire up Sentry, and document the setup so you can replicate it cleanly.
